SUPERSEDED 2026-09-04. The old text said browser gates must run HEADED and that waitUntil:networkidle never resolves headless. Measured false: 18 runs, headless 5/9 green against headed 5/9, identical renderer strings, networkidle resolving headless in 1067ms. Every gate run on 09-04 ran headless. The port was the trap, never the head.

BEFORE opening a row against a defect, grep docs/explainers/ for the symptom. Five rows (F5 F6 F7 F9 F10) were opened on 2026-08-28 against work explainers 28, 35 and 38 had already closed on 08-07. An explainer here is the record of a fix, with the mechanism at file:line and a post-fix number.

Being FIXED and being GATED are two different states and this repo has only tracked one. assert-export-plan read 11 PASS while the ends-full defect was live. A fix no gate would redden can come back silently.
Nine times in one night the answer was already on disk, and four times prose was mistaken for code. Grep the record before opening a row, and never match a module name when you mean a binding.

START THE DEV SERVER WITH THE COMMAND IN package.json AND NOTHING ELSE: `next dev`, which is TURBOPACK here. `--webpack` came from a lane note on 2026-09-04, and it BREAKS the implicit-surface Web Worker (assert-geom-offthread reports a page-level 'SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token') AND kills hot reload. It cost a whole browser battery run: 30 of 58 gates judged, 11 red, none of them findings.

`next dev` TAKES A LOCK AT .next/dev/lock — ONE PER CHECKOUT. A second one fails with 'Unable to acquire lock'. Parallel lanes that each need a server need their own COPY under ~/.fs-lanes/, which is the pattern this repo already uses.

NEVER RUN TWO BATTERIES, OR A BATTERY AND A CAPTURE, AGAINST ONE SERVER. A source save hot-reloads the page and `window.__captureHarness` disappears mid-run: the probes die with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading setPenTip)'. _probe-pentip-sweep.mjs documents three consecutive deaths from this. On 2026-09-04 it also produced TWO FALSE REDS on gates that were green an hour earlier. A browser verdict taken under concurrent load may be reporting the load.

A DEV SERVER LEFT UP FOR DAYS STOPS SEEING EDITS. pid 7765 had been up 9 days 3 hours; a token injected into a rendered string never appeared and `find .next -newermt today` returned 0. Restart it before believing any browser measurement. Filed as F84.

THE STORED EVIDENCE IN THIS REPO IS BROADLY A MONTH STALE and a PROVENANCE row is an instruction, not a defect: re-shoot with the gate's verify-* or _probe-* twin. Re-shooting is where the real findings are — assert-timing's two consecDelta NaN rows were missing frames, and screen-layers went from 'the evidence is old' to naming two live rendering defects.

A GATE'S DEFAULT LABEL MUST BE DERIVED, NOT TYPED. assert-screen-layers read arg('label','final') and 'final' was shot 2026-08-04, so the one directory it would ever look at was frozen in its own source. Same defect as assert-fusion-combo-liveness had. Re-shooting a stored label is NOT the fix: 3,818 files are tracked under screen-layers and a sibling is named same-as-final-DO-NOT-CITE.
